forbid-call.description: fails when any anchored file calls <pkg>.<func> (import-alias aware, syntax-level)

lint-tags.description: fails when a style guide's 'Covered by' linter claims disagree with the nearest golangci config above the guide — a claimed linter must be enabled, a claimed sub-check live; a [lint] headline must carry a coverage bullet; guides with no config above them pass

literal-owner.description: fails when a file outside the allowed path regexp contains the literal

forbid-addr-lit.description: fails on address-of composite literal (&T{...}) — the pre-Go-1.26 idiom new(expr) replaces

errorf-prefix.description: fails when a fmt.Errorf/errors.New message literal lacks the Component.Method: prefix (RULE-GOLANG-ERR-001)

test-schema.description: fails when t.Run names a case with anything but the house schema's test._id (RULE-GOLANG-TEST-001..005)

gofmt.description: fails when an anchored file is not gofmt-formatted (wraps gofmt -l; exit-0-with-findings normalized to the contract)

func-signature.description: fails when a FuncDecl violates RULE-GOLANG-FUNC-001: ctx first (named ctx), error last, at most 3 return values

exhaustive-switch.description: fails when a switch over a typed-constant enum misses members (ACTION-IMPL-INTEG-005); go tool exhaustive over the anchored packages

symbol-exists.description: task contract: named symbol exists in the anchored files, optionally with the planned signature

symbol-coverage.description: task contract: named function's coverage in the anchored package is at least min percent

golden-diff.description: observation anchor: GET url, normalize, materialize observed=, line-diff against the anchored golden

skill-meta.description: SKILL.md metadata checks by mode= param: version-sync (frontmatter version == changelog.json[0].version), frontmatter (required single-line keys + description shape), allowed-tools (permission-rule dialect)

skill-context.description: validates the SKILL.md frontmatter context: declaration — token grammar (entry ID or trailing-* glob), exact IDs exist in the index= file, globs match at least one entry

skill-entries.description: validates the SKILL.md entry grammar — **SKILL-<NAME>-<TOPIC>-NNN** `[class]` — statement headlines, NAME = leaf dir upper-cased without hyphens, known class tags, unique ids, payload entries followed by one fenced block; skills without entries pass

bash32-compat.description: fails when a shell script uses a bash-4+ construct — hooks/routines run under macOS bash 3.2 (launchd)

shellcheck.description: fails on shellcheck findings over the anchored scripts (brew dep, accepted Band D); missing binary is a tool error, never a silent pass

jsonschema.description: fails when an anchored JSON file does not conform to the draft-07 schema named by schema= (santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6)

rules-check.description: wraps cmd/rules by mode= param: validate (ACTION/FACT contract) or generate-check (rules.json currency); replaces the raw Makefile audit lines

evalgen-bounds.description: fails when a verifier main.go leaves the acdsl/evalgen.json bounds — line count, or an import outside stdlib/internal/go.mod requires (generation may never add a dependency)

id-grammar.description: fails when a doctrine declaration id leaves the KIND-SCOPE[-TOPIC]-NNN grammar or uses an unregistered taxonomy scope/topic; task-lifetime entries exempt

plan-format.description: lintable subset of style/plan.md over design plans: TLDR first, Changelog present, canonical section order

runbook-format.description: fails when a Bruno runbook request file lacks a non-empty docs block or an assert block (rules/runbooks.md lintable subset)
